title: Classification
summary: Logistic regression, cross-entropy, k-NN, trees, forests and honest train/test evaluation.
objectives: Compute sigmoid probabilities and binary cross-entropy
Describe how k-NN and decision trees overfit
Explain data leakage and why we split before fitting
socratic_prompts: Why is a confident wrong prediction punished more than an uncertain one?
What happens to a k-NN decision boundary as k grows?

examples.title: Scikit-learn baseline
examples.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = train_test_split(X, y, random_state=0)
print(LogisticRegression(max_iter=500).fit(Xtr, ytr).score(Xte, yte))
